children.name: Reference Lead
children.text: Connect to console, logs, and invalidation events with the correct transport, framing, permission, and reconnect behavior.

children.name: Reference 1 Row 2 Text 3
children.text: Tail the configured game log through the agent.

children.name: Reference 2 Row 1 Text 3
children.text: Use ordinary HTTP rather than opening a socket.

children.name: Reference 2 Row 2 Text 3
children.text: A socket stays bound to the cluster and namespace of the server that opened it, and reconnects retain that target. Leaving the server view closes its streams, so a new view opens fresh sockets in its own scope and never inherits stale state.

children.name: Reference 2 Row 3 Text 3
children.text: Use bounded backoff and show stale/disconnected state.

children.name: Reference Note Text
children.text: Sessions, origin rules, namespace, and cluster scope match REST; adjacent mutations still require CSRF.
